location: PDF page 2, Argument in Favor of Measure R, paragraph 1

location: PDF page 14, Argument in Favor of Measure ___, paragraph 1
excerpt: VOTE YES on _ to protect the outstanding quality of education that children attending our local TK-8 schools receive from the Cambrian School District (CSD). When our schools are strong, Cambrian is strong.
A “no” vote is a vote to not replace the tax.

When school boards ask voters permission to go into debt with bond like Measure _, they admit that every project they are currently spending your tax dollars on, now, is more important than the projects listed in this ballot measure.

A “yes” vote is a vote to levy a parcel tax of 4 cents per square foot per parcel per year on property within the District, capped annually, as stated in the Measure, at $89 per residential parcel and $7,500 per non-residential parcel, for eight years beginning July 1, 2027.
